headline: Power Minerals Secures $5 Million Funding for Brazilian Rare Earths
summary: Power Minerals received a $5 million backing from Nasdaq-listed Critical Metals Corp to support development of the Morro do Ferro rare earths project in Brazil.
why: Rare earth elements are critical raw materials for electric vehicle motors, wind turbines, and advanced electronics, driving global exploration investment.

impacts.name: Critical Metals Corp
impacts.why: Critical Metals Corp provides $5M backing for rare earth project exploration.
